categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily operates in the manufacturing and sales of copper foil substrates (CCL), adhesive films, and multilayer laminated boards used in printed circuit boards (PCBs). It focuses on high-speed digital (HSD) substrates for AI servers, HDI/SLP substrates for mobile devices, and substrate materials for electronic products including IC substrates and carrier boards.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes advanced technologies in producing halogen-free base materials and adhesive films, high-frequency and high-speed transmission substrates, and environmentally friendly materials. Manufacturing processes include resin coating, lamination, hot pressing, and inspection, with a strong emphasis on R&D for next-generation products in AI computing, high-speed transmission, automotive, aerospace, and industrial applications.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers are major domestic and international PCB manufacturers serving markets such as AI servers, general servers, switches, data storage, mobile devices, automotive electronics, satellite communications, and industrial electronics. The company maintains strong relationships with leading PCB makers and targets high-growth sectors like AI edge computing and 5G communications.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates manufacturing plants in Taiwan and multiple locations in China including Kunshan, Zhongshan, and Huangshi, with additional subsidiaries in Malaysia (Penang). It serves global markets with a focus on Asia, including Taiwan, China, Southeast Asia, and expanding overseas to diversify risk.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily in the upstream to midstream segment of the PCB supply chain, producing key base materials such as copper foil substrates and adhesive films that are essential inputs for PCB manufacturers downstream. It also engages in some downstream activities through subsidiaries involved in substrate assembly and processing.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include maintaining global leadership in halogen-free and high-speed digital substrates, expanding capacity, and developing high-end automotive and satellite communication materials. R&D focuses on environmentally friendly materials, high-frequency substrates for AI and 5G, and next-generation products for edge computing, aerospace, and autonomous vehicles. The company actively builds intellectual property through patents to protect innovations.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through product sales of copper foil substrates, adhesive films, and multilayer laminated boards to PCB manufacturers. The company also benefits from licensing its proprietary technologies and maintains long-term supply agreements with key customers to ensure stable sales.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is positioned as a global leader in halogen-free base materials and HDI/SLP substrates, holding the number one market share worldwide in these segments. It competes with other major PCB material suppliers but distinguishes itself through product innovation, quality, and extensive patent holdings, ranking fourth globally in patents for copper foil substrates.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: The company reported consolidated revenues of approximately NT$64.4 billion in 2023, a 55.9% increase from the prior year, with net profit rising 74.3% to NT$9.57 billion. Asset base and equity have grown significantly due to capacity expansion and profitability improvements. Cash flows from operations increased substantially, supporting ongoing investments in production facilities.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes environmentally friendly, high-performance materials that meet the stringent requirements of high-speed, high-frequency, and AI computing applications. Its products offer low signal loss, high reliability, and compliance with global green standards. Strong R&D capabilities and a robust patent portfolio provide competitive differentiation and enable rapid commercialization of next-generation substrates.
